name: OntologyAuthorPolicy
description: Policy for authoring ontologies: create, edit and delete ontologies, concepts, properties, axioms and change sets, read releases, and request a release review.

rules.name: OntologyAuthorPolicy-AuthorRule
rules.description: Allow authors to create, edit, delete and view the content of an ontology.

rules.name: OntologyAuthorPolicy-ReleaseRule
rules.description: Allow authors to read releases and to request a review of one.
